text: 全球大类资产波动加剧，外资看好中国资产配置机遇 中国股票、债券与海外资产相关性偏低，所处经济周期、增长动力均存在差异，分散配置效果突出。
text_en: Volatility in global major asset classes has intensified, and foreign investors are optimistic about opportunities in Chinese asset allocation. Chinese stocks and bonds have low correlation with overseas assets, and differ in their economic cycles and growth drivers, making diversified allocation particularly effective.
